frame_controls.limits: Exercises the exact parser suffix of the experimental helper using synthetic stdout; no Cargo, provider, protected registration or production state.

source_confinement_precondition_red.problem: A valid frame reporting writable fixture source is emitted as business data instead of refusing setup.

limits: The initial experiment was deliberately stopped only after a known setup error was identified, not because observation timed out. Original live native workflows were unchanged.
Parser controls execute the exact parsing suffix of the prototype using synthetic child stdout; they do not certify source-copy custody, a native baseline or an end-to-end workflow.

The proposed source-confinement refusal is staged separately while the running source stays frozen. Its positive and negative business values both emit data; writable-source setup emits no behavioral data.

The scoper installer permits Python harnesses only under autoship_verifiers, whereas the exploratory helper used scripts. The next staged launcher uses the allowed dedicated path. No installation allowlist is bypassed.
A portable Cargo lookup from the existing controller-provided PATH is staged. The active experiment retains its original fixed local-tool path.
Working source-copy, candidate/mutant execution, complete bounded cleanup and independent registration/review remain open. No production patch, capacity setting or enrolled verifier changed.
